05·about
05 · concept & rules

A grading duel,
photo by photo.

grading-game is a photo color-grading game. You're given an image — a RAW file, a negative scan, a flat export — and a time limit to develop it in the software of your choice before re-importing it into the round.

In multiplayer, every submission is then revealed anonymously. Each player rates the others' grades (except their own). A winner is declared at the end.

  1. A source image is picked at random and presented to every player.
  2. Download the original (RAW / TIFF / DNG depending on the challenge).
  3. Grade it however you like in the software you prefer — Lightroom, Capture One, DaVinci, Darktable.
  4. Re-import your final JPEG before the timer runs out.
  5. In multiplayer, vote on the other players' anonymous submissions.
